question: Among the players whose height is over 180, how many of them have a volley score of over 70?
evidence: height > 180; volley score refers to volleys; volleys > 70;
clarification: Count every row, including repeated id values.
gold: SELECT COUNT(t1.id) FROM Player AS t1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS t2 ON t1.player_api_id = t2.player_api_id WHERE t1.height > 180 AND t2.volleys > 70
gold0: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t1.id) FROM Player AS t1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS t2 ON t1.player_api_id = t2.player_api_id WHERE t1.height > 180 AND t2.volleys > 70

d.request: How many rows have a height over 180 and a volleys score over 70, counting rows with repeated ID values separately?
d.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Player_Attributes AS pa JOIN Player AS p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id WHERE p.height > 180 AND pa.volleys > 70;

c.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Player AS p JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id WHERE p.height > 180 AND pa.volleys > 70;

b.request: Count Player_Attributes rows with volleys > 70 for players whose height is > 180, including multiple rows for the same player
b.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Player_Attributes AS pa JOIN Player AS p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id WHERE pa.volleys > 70 AND p.height > 180
